title: AccountUsage

accountId.description: An account's id on its environment: a version 4 UUID the environment mints when it adopts or adds the account; an account carried over from configuration keeps the id it was configured with.

provider.description: A provider's id, as the environment's adapter registry keys it: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens (claude).

email.description: The login's email, as the provider's status reports it.

organisation.description: The organisation the login belongs to, when the provider reports one.

anyOf.description: Who an account signed in as: the provider, the email and the organisation when present; one account per identity per environment.

identity.description: Who the account is signed in as, which a client pools readings by across environments; null when it has never been read.

window.description: The window, in the provider's words: five_hour, seven_day, model_scoped:<model>, extra_usage.

utilisation.description: How much of the window is used, 0 to 1 and beyond; null when the provider does not say.

anyOf.description: An instant as an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.

resetsAt.description: When the window rolls over; null when the provider does not say.

anyOf.description: The latest rate-limit verdict a run of the account reported for the window (plan.limit): allowed, warning (near the limit) or rejected (refused until the reset, whatever the utilisation reads).

verdict.description: The latest verdict a run reported for the window, folded in after the read; null when none has been heard since.

observedAt.description: When this window's numbers were observed: the reading's readAt, or the instant of a run's report folded into it since, which is never before readAt. What a client pooling two readings of one identity compares per window.

items.description: One plan window of an account's reading: how much is used, when it resets, and the latest verdict a run reported for it.

windows.description: The plan's windows, in the provider's order; empty when the reading is unavailable.

readAt.description: When the provider was read for this reading; when the provider's own stamp was in the future or already six minutes old, when the environment was handed it. A reading is read again once it is six minutes old.

unavailableReason.description: Why the reading has no windows, when it has none: the adapter reports no plan usage, the account is not signed in, the read failed, or the provider reported no limits (an API-key login). A client shows the reason in place of a gauge. Null on a reading with windows.

description: One account's plan usage: its identity, its windows, when it was read, and why it has no windows when it has none.
